finding.summary: The timed InvokeAsync overload creates a timeout CTS per interop call.
finding.explanation: Each finite-timeout call constructs and disposes a CancellationTokenSource, scheduling timer-queue work for that JavaScript invocation. The overload may be used on high-frequency interop paths, but caller frequency is not visible here, so the occurrence is likely.

notes: Independent public IJSRuntime explicit-timeout owner; current baseline/source and public token-consumer contract investigation started. F097 finalized as private-default allocation draft105; no F098 shipping edit, benchmark comparison or disposition yet.
